features.name: ink_density_norm
features.description: Total ink normalized by the 8x8 maximum intensity, giving a smooth brightness and density measure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures overall stroke amount and helps a linear margin separate sparse glyphs from dense or over-written glyphs.
features.formula: (input1 + input2 + input3 + input4 + input5 + input6 + input7 + input8 + input9 + input10 + input11 + input12 + input13 + input14 + input15 + input16 + input17 + input18 + input19 + input20 + input21 + input22 + input23 + input24 + input25 + input26 + input27 + input28 + input29 + input30 + input31 + input32 + input33 + input34 + input35 + input36 + input37 + input38 + input39 + input40 + input41 + input42 + input43 + input44 + input45 + input46 + input47 + input48 + input49 + input50 + input51 + input52 + input53 + input54 + input55 + input56 + input57 + input58 + input59 + input60 + input61 + input62 + input63 + input64) / 1024.0

features.formula: ((12.25 * (input1 + input2 + input3 + input4 + input5 + input6 + input7 + input8)) + (6.25 * (input9 + input10 + input11 + input12 + input13 + input14 + input15 + input16)) + (2.25 * (input17 + input18 + input19 + input20 + input21 + input22 + input23 + input24)) + (0.25 * (input25 + input26 + input27 + input28 + input29 + input30 + input31 + input32)) + (0.25 * (input33 + input34 + input35 + input36 + input37 + input38 + input39 + input40)) + (2.25 * (input41 + input42 + input43 + input44 + input45 + input46 + input47 + input48)) + (6.25 * (input49 + input50 + input51 + input52 + input53 + input54 + input55 + input56)) + (12.25 * (input57 + input58 + input59 + input60 + input61 + input62 + input63 + input64))) / (12.25 * (input1 + input2 + input3 + input4 + input5 + input6 + input7 + input8 + input9 + input10 + input11 + input12 + input13 + input14 + input15 + input16 + input17 + input18 + input19 + input20 + input21 + input22 + input23 + input24 + input25 + input26 + input27 + input28 + input29 + input30 + input31 + input32 + input33 + input34 + input35 + input36 + input37 + input38 + input39 + input40 + input41 + input42 + input43 + input44 + input45 + input46 + input47 + input48 + input49 + input50 + input51 + input52 + input53 + input54 + input55 + input56 + input57 + input58 + input59 + input60 + input61 + input62 + input63 + input64) + 1.0)

features.name: central_ink_fraction
features.description: Fraction of ink inside the central 4x4 block, measured relative to total ink with a stabilizing offset.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures whether the glyph is center-filled or mostly outlined, a strong smooth cue for many handwritten forms.
features.formula: (input19 + input20 + input21 + input22 + input27 + input28 + input29 + input30 + input35 + input36 + input37 + input38 + input43 + input44 + input45 + input46) / (input1 + input2 + input3 + input4 + input5 + input6 + input7 + input8 + input9 + input10 + input11 + input12 + input13 + input14 + input15 + input16 + input17 + input18 + input19 + input20 + input21 + input22 + input23 + input24 + input25 + input26 + input27 + input28 + input29 + input30 + input31 + input32 + input33 + input34 + input35 + input36 + input37 + input38 + input39 + input40 + input41 + input42 + input43 + input44 + input45 + input46 + input47 + input48 + input49 + input50 + input51 + input52 + input53 + input54 + input55 + input56 + input57 + input58 + input59 + input60 + input61 + input62 + input63 + input64 + 1.0)

features.name: border_ink_fraction
features.description: Fraction of ink on the outer border cells, measured relative to total ink with a stabilizing offset.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes whether strokes hug the frame versus stay central, giving a robust outline and cropping cue.
features.formula: (input1 + input2 + input3 + input4 + input5 + input6 + input7 + input8 + input57 + input58 + input59 + input60 + input61 + input62 + input63 + input64 + input9 + input17 + input25 + input33 + input41 + input49 + input16 + input24 + input32 + input40 + input48 + input56) / (input1 + input2 + input3 + input4 + input5 + input6 + input7 + input8 + input9 + input10 + input11 + input12 + input13 + input14 + input15 + input16 + input17 + input18 + input19 + input20 + input21 + input22 + input23 + input24 + input25 + input26 + input27 + input28 + input29 + input30 + input31 + input32 + input33 + input34 + input35 + input36 + input37 + input38 + input39 + input40 + input41 + input42 + input43 + input44 + input45 + input46 + input47 + input48 + input49 + input50 + input51 + input52 + input53 + input54 + input55 + input56 + input57 + input58 + input59 + input60 + input61 + input62 + input63 + input64 + 1.0)

features.name: diagonal_ink_contrast
features.description: Signed contrast between the main diagonal and the opposite diagonal of the 8x8 grid.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a slant-sensitive projection that helps linear margins exploit rising or falling stroke patterns.
features.formula: ((input1 + input10 + input19 + input28 + input37 + input46 + input55 + input64) - (input8 + input15 + input22 + input29 + input36 + input43 + input50 + input57)) / 128.0

features.name: horizontal_bar_balance
features.description: Relative strength of upper horizontal bands versus lower horizontal bands, using the inner six columns of the top two and bottom two rows.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures top-heavy versus bottom-heavy bar structure with a bounded ratio suited to a linear SVM.
features.formula: ((input2 + input3 + input4 + input5 + input6 + input7 + input10 + input11 + input12 + input13 + input14 + input15) - (input50 + input51 + input52 + input53 + input54 + input55 + input58 + input59 + input60 + input61 + input62 + input63)) / (input2 + input3 + input4 + input5 + input6 + input7 + input10 + input11 + input12 + input13 + input14 + input15 + input50 + input51 + input52 + input53 + input54 + input55 + input58 + input59 + input60 + input61 + input62 + input63 + 1.0)

features.name: central_hollow_proxy
features.description: Bounded contrast between a bright ring around the central 4x4 area and the four innermost cells, acting as a hollow-center cue.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights closed or nearly closed central structure while remaining a smooth bounded score for margin learning.
features.formula: np.clip(((input19 + input20 + input21 + input22 + input27 + input30 + input35 + input38 + input43 + input44 + input45 + input46) - (input28 + input29 + input36 + input37)) / (input19 + input20 + input21 + input22 + input27 + input30 + input35 + input38 + input43 + input44 + input45 + input46 + input28 + input29 + input36 + input37 + 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: semantic_loop_count
features.description: Rater-estimated number of enclosed interior openings visible in the rendered 8x8 glyph; fractional values express ambiguity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a high-level closed-structure cue that can complement pixel composites when shapes are noisy or partially written.

features.name: semantic_angularity_score
features.description: Rater-estimated degree of sharp, straight, or corner-like strokes in the rendered 8x8 glyph; 0 means mostly rounded and 1 means strongly angular.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds high-level stroke texture not fully captured by coarse ink moments, improving margin placement for visually similar glyphs.
